title: Fact
description: One number or rule shown to users. Every charge, rate, slab, fee or limit in data/ is a Fact, so the page can show its source and 'last verified' date.

value.description: The number, string, or structured value (e.g. a slab table).

source.description: Official page the value was read from.

checked.description: Date a person last confirmed the value at the source (YYYY-MM-DD).
